item: Archive backfill no longer records a Stop as an empty history or a passed-over URL
summary: The Export lane's stop-and-record sweep (R325 item 1) found that advance_backfill checked the kill switch only at the head of the tick and of each URL, so a Stop inside the sitemap enumeration returned an empty or part-read list that was recorded as done (never re-queued, or walked as the whole archive), and a URL cut in flight was tallied fetch_failed and passed over for good. The tick now returns skipped_offline: 1 (the R296/R313 key every other recorder uses, not a new sentence, per R327) with source_id when the switch is engaged after the enumeration, saving nothing so the entry stays at the head of the queue, and stops at a URL whose fetch_failed or exception outcome arrives with the switch engaged, leaving the cursor on it; a tick that held URLs back says skipped_offline: 1 on its final dict. A URL finished before the Stop keeps its place, and an honest empty enumeration and a really failed URL are unchanged and carry no key. 12 new test cases (the enumeration with the seam, with a raising enumerator and with the real make_fetcher() over a scripted session, a part-read list, the URL cut with the seam and through the real ingest_url for a cut robots read and a cut page, a raising URL, a URL finished before the Stop, three controls), 9 red against the parent source, 11 of 12 mutants red (the twelfth is equivalent). A Stop cleared again inside one request's flight stays the stated limit; an engagement epoch is a proposal for the user list.
